authenticated case-scoped user fact or filing election
reviewed typed domain component with provenance

contracts.semantic_scope: one bounded securities-disposal operation tax model
one complete bounded securities category for one tax period
one complete bounded securities-derived income-group tax base

component_inventory.rule: A bounded contract may be cited only as published_bounded; mark missing when no listed contract belongs to the expected semantic family.

evidence_policy_families.meaning: The Definition itself makes the domain applicable; negative applicability evidence is forbidden.
Occurrence facts or a validated component establish applicability; exact authenticated negative attestation or exhaustive coverage is usable only when explicitly allowlisted and unconflicted.
A reviewed published typed classification over authoritative inputs decides applicability; a declarant denial is not decision authority.
An authenticated filing election establishes applicability and an authenticated non-election can close scope; eligibility and value remain typed component concerns.
Only an exact period-and-domain coverage receipt can establish absence; declarant denial alone is forbidden.

granularity_principles: One root domain has one understandable applicability question for the case and period.
One root domain activates one coherent typed semantic component family.
One root domain uses one compatible evidence-policy family.
A root domain remains meaningful if the target XML or PDF layout changes.
Split meanings with different applicability or evidence owners; keep value-level variants inside a domain component.
Account for every official surface and give no domain a layout-only justification.

surface_requirements.locator: title sheet; procedure paragraphs 15-16; electronic title contract
surface_requirements.semantic_requirement: Every declaration identifies the filing instance and correction, tax period, destination authority, taxpayer and period-relevant taxpayer status, and the signer or representative with supporting authority where representation is used.

surface_requirements.locator: mandatory Section 1; procedure paragraph 15 and Section 1 procedure
surface_requirements.semantic_requirement: Every declaration states the declaration-level tax disposition, including budget allocation meanings for tax payable, additional payment, reduction or refund.

surface_requirements.locator: application to Section 1; procedure paragraph 15 and application procedure
surface_requirements.semantic_requirement: A taxpayer may elect to request disposal of an established refundable amount and, for a bank refund, provide the destination account semantics.
Every declaration contains a non-empty set of applicable income-group tax-base and tax-settlement results, with a separate coherent calculation for each income group.
When relevant, the declaration accounts for taxable income from sources in the Russian Federation and its source, income-kind and tax-agent semantics.
When relevant, the declaration accounts for taxable income from sources outside the Russian Federation, source jurisdiction and foreign-tax-credit semantics.
When relevant, the declaration accounts for entrepreneurial, advocate, notarial or other private-practice income, expenses, advances and professional deductions.
When relevant, the declaration accounts for income legally exempt from taxation and amounts within or above applicable exemption limits.
When claimed, the declaration accounts for standard, social, investment and long-term-savings deduction families and their eligible amounts.
When relevant, the declaration accounts for property, vehicle, rights or gift disposition income and related deductions or expense reductions.
When claimed, the declaration accounts for property acquisition, construction and related interest deduction semantics.
When relevant, the declaration accounts for securities, derivatives, digital financial assets or rights, investment-partnership and related loss or deduction semantics.

surface_requirements.locator: calculation to Appendix 1; procedure paragraphs following Appendix 8
surface_requirements.semantic_requirement: When relevant, property-disposition semantics include object-level proceeds, basis, deduction and taxable-result calculations needed by the declaration.

surface_requirements.locator: calculation to Appendix 5; procedure calculation provisions
surface_requirements.semantic_requirement: When relevant, social and investment deduction semantics include the eligible expense categories and limit calculations needed by the declaration.

runtime_capability_contract.authoring_constraint: Capabilities are evidence of current architecture only; do not copy them into the Definition and do not design runtime control flow.

capabilities.meaning: Resolve each closed semantic requirement from the current Financial Case first and then from eligible same-run user supplemental facts, retaining exactly one tagged source when satisfied.
Ask for and deterministically accept one currently missing money value from a human, persist it in trusted case scope, and recheck the requirement.

Resolve one exact published behavior and execute only its statically registered deterministic implementation over its exact registered typed input, returning its exact registered typed output in a common provenance-retaining envelope.

Resolve one exact repository-published evidence-bound declaration projection and deterministically project its exact registered stable semantic input into a bounded declaration-shaped fragment without calculation.
Aggregate a non-empty compatible set of complete operation models for one taxpayer, category and tax period, and admit complete category semantics only with exact member-set completeness evidence.

trial_instructions.output: Return exactly one JSON object and no Markdown or commentary.
rules: Use only supplied official evidence for declaration requirements.
Derive the domain partition yourself; no prior partition is supplied.
Use stable target-independent business meanings, not target layout names.
Choose exactly one closed applicability evidence-policy family per domain.
Do not create component contracts; cite only supplied contract IDs or mark the family missing.
Do not write formulas, executable conditions, predicates, workflows, questions, code or case-time behavior.
Do not emit target tags, paths, ordering, namespaces, coordinates, encoding, XML, PDF or tax payable.
trial_instructions.task: Independently derive the smallest complete root semantic-domain manifest needed to decide scope for the supplied declaration identity.
